children: The global markets environment won't be as robust in Q3 2026 as it was in Q2, which was a "lights-out quarter by any measure," Bank of America
Co-President Jim DeMare said at an investor conference on Wednesday.

The executive sees room for the bank to expand its credit card business by marketing to its existing client base. Only 7% of Bank of America's traditional banking clients have a BofA credit card, he noted. That approach can be applied to other businesses within the bank. "We have opportunities to do more with the clients that we have relationships with today," he said.
Another example is that its traditional banking services could provide a funnel for its wealth platform.

Furthermore, applying a critical eye to the companies' individual businesses will offer opportunities for incremental growth. "You can go across commercial banking — can go across each sector — and you'll find that we're really good, but we can be better," DeMare said. "And those are the opportunities that that we think are going to drive better client value and are going to drive help drive shareholder value as well."
stock was roughly flat in early Wednesday trading.

title: Bank of America sees less-robust markets in Q3; highlights growth opportunities across businesses
